purpose: Every correction the owner has had to make, as a failure class with its instances and a detector. Owner conditions 2026-11-17 (docs/self-evaluation.md): corrections must influence future planning and evaluation (7); the owner's corrective intervention must decrease (8); the self-improvement mechanism is not successful until it detects and corrects a previously observed class without the owner pointing it out again. An instance observed_by 'owner' is an intervention; observed_by 'mechanism' is a detection the owner did not have to make.
